LESSON: WRITING 11.4.1 GUIDED WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Writing 11.4.1 Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 11.4.1 Guided Writing, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do pictures or picture descriptions help us to write an essay?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 11.4.1 Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and Imagination: A learner’s ability to explore is enhanced as they create sentences from pictures or picture descriptions.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is enhanced as the learner work in groups collaboratively.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (self-esteem) learner’s self-esteem is enhanced as they express oneself effectively through writing.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner uses the writing skills acquired to write concepts in learning areas such as creative activities, environmental activities among others.

Suggested learning resources

• Textbooks in print and in braille

• Audio recording

• Digital devices with assistive technology
